prompt.initial:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: Japanese basketball news thumbnail, ONE finished landscape image, 16:9 aspect ratio, 1536 x 864 pixels or larger. Opaque PNG.
Primary request: Create an editorial hand-drawn basketball thumbnail for the fixed article "11/20 試合結果・当日のEFF". This is a roundup, not a story about an individual player. Use a real athlete as an illustrative subject: Issei Tomida (富田一成). He was randomly chosen from the names in the supplied article, so do not print his name, jersey number, team name, or individual stats, and do not imply a specific actual game moment.

Subject likeness: Draw exactly one real player, Issei Tomida, in an energetic, low forward driving stance holding an orange basketball at his hip with one hand, other arm naturally bent. Face clearly visible in a near-front three-quarter view. Based on his inspected official 2026-27 portrait from https://samuraiz.jp/team/players/detail/id=16112?PlayerID=36969 and its official portrait https://bleague.bl.kuroco-img.app/v=2026102419/files/user/roster/750/2026-27/36969_01.jpg : Japanese man in his late twenties, thick black tousled wavy hair with a dense voluminous top and short sides, uneven curled fringe falling lightly across the forehead; dark, slightly rounded almond eyes and fairly straight eyebrows; elongated oval face, softly squared jaw, medium full cheeks, straight medium-length nose with rounded tip, closed lips with fuller lower lip, no beard or mustache. Strong neck and broad athletic shoulders, muscular natural proportions. Keep these specific facial features recognisable in drawn ink; not a generic invented player. No headband. Outfit: plain off-white basketball singlet and dark shorts with restrained lime edging. Absolutely no words, numbers, logos, brands or sponsors on clothing. This is a newly drawn illustration, never paste the official photo or make it photorealistic.

Style/medium: Match the inspected approved black-and-lime v3 thumbnail style: near-black #151A18 background, electric lime #CCF43B, warm white typography, bold black ink outlines, sketchy brush strokes and restrained crosshatching in the athlete. Orange basketball only as a prop in the player's hand. Minimal elements, vigorous editorial sports illustration, high contrast, handcrafted brush texture. No photographic textures or realistic photo skin. Lime diagonal brush sweep behind athlete, sparing ink flecks. Keep text areas calm and solid.

Composition: Fresh dynamic composition, player on the LEFT 44% of canvas from head through bent knees, driving diagonally toward the middle, face unobstructed, orange ball fully visible lower-left-center with natural hand grasp. Keep face, hands and ball entirely inside canvas. Large stacked Japanese headline on the RIGHT 52%. Separate illustration from all lettering. Small masthead at upper right, date below. Main headline "試合結果" in very large heavy white Japanese gothic type. Second headline "当日のEFF" in large lime type. Small supporting line under it "ポジション別TOP3". Plenty of readable negative space. Avoid scoreboards, tables, card illustrations, trophies or extra people. All text inside 5% safe margins. Bottom full-width quiet dark footer with the two short labels legible in off-white.

Text (verbatim, print only these seven lines):
"バスケまとめ"
"2026.11.20"
"試合結果"
"当日のEFF"
"ポジション別TOP3"
"イラスト（AI生成）"
"イメージ"

Factual constraints: The headline describes the day's results and official daily EFF ranked by position, not season averages or a prediction. Do not add individual scores, rankings or names to the randomly chosen player. Do not add fantasy-card scores or any other facts. Keep the AI label and the word イメージ clear and accurate. Do not depict a claimed winning shot, actual matchup, or official photograph. No league or team logos. Hands and limb anatomy must be plausible, no extra fingers, no cut-off face, no clipped letters. Render Japanese exactly as supplied. One finished thumbnail only.
